description: This file defines an enumeration for menu item highlight colors, including a nested Palette struct and functions to determine primary and secondary colors based on a highlighted state.

classes.name: MenuItemHighlightColors
classes.description: An enum providing static methods and a nested struct for managing highlight colors for menu items.

classes.name: Palette
classes.description: A struct within MenuItemHighlightColors that holds primary and secondary Color properties.

methods.name: primary
methods.description: Returns the primary highlight color based on whether the item is highlighted.

methods.name: secondary
methods.description: Returns the secondary highlight color with adjusted opacity if highlighted.

methods.name: palette
methods.description: Constructs and returns a Palette struct with appropriate primary and secondary colors based on highlighted state.
